summary: Make website/public/release.json the single public-release identity authority consumed by repository security, release-consistency, and rendered-site tests.

providedInputs.label: Owner-provided ScadMill functional specification v0.6 with amendments through A-11

decisions.decision: Derive the expected public version, installer filename, byte size, SHA-256, release URL, and download URL from website/public/release.json in release-policy tests, while retaining CANDIDATE_VERSION as the separate application-candidate authority.
decisions.rationale: Duplicating exact release identity values in test constants made every publication a coordinated test rewrite and allowed the test oracle itself to drift. One metadata authority preserves cross-surface enforcement without pinning the current release into test code.

testEvidence.criterion: Release-policy tests must consume release.json and contain no literal beta version, release hash, or installer-size constant.
testEvidence.test: Add a source-policy test covering the release metadata, security policy, and rendered HTML test files, then derive every release identity assertion from release.json.

red.outcome: RED: 1 test file failed and 1 test failed because tests/scripts/release-metadata.test.ts contained literal candidate/public beta versions, installer size, and SHA-256 instead of deriving public identity from release.json.

green.outcome: GREEN: 1 test file passed and 1 test passed after the three release-policy tests consumed release.json and the remaining derived SHA-256 alias was removed.

testEvidence.criterion: The single metadata authority must remain fail-closed when its installer identity is internally inconsistent with its version and public surfaces.
testEvidence.test: Temporarily prefix the authoritative installer filename with BROKEN-, run the release metadata suite, restore the exact file, and rerun the focused policy suite.

red.outcome: FALSIFICATION RED: 1 test file failed; 2 tests failed and 7 passed. The suite rejected both the malformed version-derived installer name and the resulting mismatch with README.md.

green.command: pnpm exec vitest run tests/scripts/release-metadata-authority.test.ts tests/scripts/release-metadata.test.ts tests/scripts/security-policy.test.ts
green.outcome: RESTORED GREEN: 3 test files passed and 11 tests passed; git diff --exit-code confirmed website/public/release.json matched the original bytes.

nearMisses.sought: Reject every semantic-version-looking literal in release-policy tests.
nearMisses.confirmation: The broad pattern incorrectly rejected the required OpenSCAD 2026.06.12 engine identity. The authority check now derives the current public and candidate versions plus release SHA-256 and rejects those exact duplicated identities, preserving unrelated versioned product requirements.

attestation: No prohibited source was consulted in producing this change.
